structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun bonding-curve coin called "Groyper", about 10 to 21 minutes old, launched through uxento. Its description says creator fees go to @groypergreg via UsePaid. It pumped about 370% within its first 10 minutes (about $140k volume, about 2,000 transactions). At roughly $20k market cap it is already about 46% below its ATH price (3.69e-5 vs 2.0e-5). GeckoTerminal's last 5 minutes show only 16 unique buyers and $3k volume, against about 609 buyers in the first 15 minutes. That points to a burst that is already cooling. At least 10 same-name Groyper tokens exist, several launched in the same hour, one named after Nick Fuentes. The project website link in the packet points to a different mint (2rgM...).

narrative.description: A Groyper / Nick Fuentes political-meme wave. It looks like a trending moment in that niche is setting off a swarm of same-name launches, and one tries to tie fees to a 'GroyperGreg' X account.
narrative.why_spreading: Some external Groyper/Fuentes trigger (a tweet or status link) is setting off rapid copycat launches. Attention is split across many tickers, and the niche is controversial, which limits mainstream KOL uptake.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has the most volume among the fresh Groyper launches in this hour, and its description names a fee recipient, @groypergreg.
